For each shared field: which functions CHANGE it and which functions USE it.

  [R] = READS / USES this field         (reference, .value, collect)
  [WR] = Both reads and writes          (toggle, increment, transform)

================================================================================
SECTION 5: FIELD-LEVEL DATA FLOW — WRITERS vs READERS
For each shared field: which functions CHANGE it and which functions USE it.
If you modify a WRITER, every READER is potentially impacted.
If you modify a READER, check what the WRITERS produce.

  [W] = WRITES / CHANGES this field    (add, assign, .value =, .emit)
  [R] = READS / USES this field         (reference, .value, collect)
  [WR] = Both reads and writes          (toggle, increment, transform)
